producer_report.summary:
I revised docs/design/native-pr-landing.md to answer review 2's F1-F8. I also added decision D85 and a CHANGELOG entry. This was docs only, so I did not run cargo fmt, clippy or test. A search of docs/ for the banned boundary words found none.

- **Status and notes:** The status line and a revision note show the revision after review 2. E1 and E2 are labeled as reported, not reproduced.
- **F1, F6:** Step 3 stores the pull request number in both modes. Step 5 looks the merge up by that number. The text now says a landed job is identified from records, never from the trailers of the merged commit. The "trailers survive" claim is gone. §5.3 adds a note on the retry path. §8 names a test with a hand-built commit that ends in a Co-authored-by paragraph after the Athena trailers.
- **F2:** New §5.6 chooses one pull request per job. A user who squashes several relies on M30. It covers the naming limit and the many-to-one stealth bookkeeping. It also covers the inherited `previous_job` gap, which squash-chain-landing.md now says is closed: the core derives it. I did not check that the build matches that text.
- **F3:** New §5.7 says the design supplies per-job pull requests, not automatic re-verification. A stale job is re-verified only when the user asks, as a new budgeted job. The roadmap order is to change separately, and the roadmap is untouched.
- **F4:** §5.4 records that two host-merged pull requests can produce unverified content and that stealth has no audit. It adds a pre-report check that the merged content equals the verified fingerprint, and a row for it in §8.
- **F5:** Stealth mode writes no model Co-Authored-By unless the user asks. The leak check separates Athena's own line from one the host adds on squash.
- **F7:** A new §10 table records the re-check. The BRIEF.md 459-466 reference, the athena-v0-review-1 reference (now lines 626-627), the athena-v0 reference (now 1446-1449) and the enforcement.md M23 row all matched the files. The citations of run.rs and invariant.rs lines come from review 2 and are marked unchecked.
- **F8:** §9 gains the four user questions, each with the assumption taken.

checks_run.command: Grep for banned boundary words under docs/

open_issues: run.rs and invariant.rs line numbers in the design come from review 2 and are marked unchecked.
Whether the squash-chain build matches its previous_job text was not checked.
Roadmap order still needs a separate job.
The four user questions are answered only by assumption.
mistakes: First inserted D85 before D84 in decisions.md, then moved it to the end.
learnings: decisions.md is chronological; last entry was D84, so the new entry is D85.
BRIEF.md 459-466, athena-v0-review-1 626-627, athena-v0 1446-1449 and the M23 row all matched the design's claims.
squash-chain-landing.md now says the core derives previous_job (R2-M1 accepted), so that gap is closed in text.
desires: Read access to crates/ line numbers was not needed, but re-checking run.rs/invariant.rs citations would have closed F7 fully.
